howtos.title: Babysit long unattended agent runs to completion
howtos.what: swyx's open skill: run at low effort, then watch traces and spot-check output with a stronger model.
copy: Detach the runs so they continue without you.
Inspect traces and output quality, not just process health or valid schemas.
Periodically spot-check outputs with a stronger model.
howtos.whenToUse: When throughput matters more than per-call quality and agent runs go unattended for long stretches.
